The Code Editor is a programming environment for analysis, not an image browser. (Earth Engine Explorer, the old lightweight viewer, has been discontinued.) Timelapse, once a separate site, is today a feature inside Google Earth (Landsat and Sentinel-2 mosaics 1984–2022).

✔ Correct

Google provides the official Earth Engine client libraries for JavaScript (the Code Editor) and Python. Two answers are correct (Python and JavaScript); the question counts as correct only with exactly these two ticked.
